name: mr-behavior-lens
description: Review GitLab merge requests as before/after behavior sequence diagrams

commands.title: MR Lens: Set Anthropic API Key

mrLens.gitlab.url.markdownDescription: GitLab instance base URL. For self-hosted / enterprise GitLab set your instance URL, e.g. `https://gitlab.mycompany.com`.

mrLens.gitlab.token.markdownDescription: GitLab personal access token (`read_api` scope; `api` scope to post comments). Takes precedence over the token stored via **MR Lens: Set GitLab Token**. ⚠️ Stored as plain text in settings — for better security leave this empty and use the command instead (secret storage).

mrLens.gitlab.projectId.description: GitLab project ID or URL-encoded path (e.g. group%2Fproject). Empty = derive from the workspace git remote.

mrLens.provider.description: LLM provider. auto = try VSCode Language Model API (Copilot) first, fall back to Anthropic API key.

mrLens.model.classify.description: Model for the cheap classification stage. Empty = lowest-tier provider default (Anthropic: claude-haiku-4-5, vscode-lm: smallest available).

mrLens.model.analyze.description: Model for the main analysis stage. Empty = lowest-tier provider default (Anthropic: claude-haiku-4-5, vscode-lm: smallest available). Pick a bigger model here for deeper reviews.

mrLens.tokenBudget.description: Ask for confirmation before a review that is estimated to exceed this many input tokens.

mrLens.maxGroups.description: Maximum number of behavior groups analyzed per merge request.

mrLens.contextBytesPerGroup.description: Cap on extra LSP context (callers/callees) attached per behavior group, in bytes.
